answer: For every identity an operator wants, it must fund a separate unrelated plume sponsor that burns sable larger than any sable burn already recorded under that operator's juniper count. A sponsor's burn is one-shot, so each identity requires a new plume sponsor. Consequently, k fakes force burns of 1, 2, ..., k sable, totaling k(k+1)/2. Later identities under the same operator see the same ladder.
